content.shortDescription: Calcula el pago mensual de tu préstamo de auto, intereses totales y costo total de financiamiento.
content.shortDescription_en: Calculate your monthly car loan payment, total interest costs, and total vehicle purchase financing cost.
content.longDescription: Estima el costo mensual de financiar un automóvil nuevo o usado. Incluye el precio del vehículo, enganche inicial, valor de intercambio (trade-in), tasa de interés y plazo del préstamo.
content.longDescription_en: Estimate the monthly cost of financing a new or used vehicle. Includes vehicle price, down payment, trade-in value, interest rate, and loan term.
howToUse: Ingresa el precio del vehículo y la divisa seleccionada.
Indica el enganche inicial en efectivo o el valor de tu auto a cuenta (trade-in).
Establece el tipo de interés anual (TIN) y la duración del préstamo en meses.
Consulta el pago mensual y los intereses totales acumulados.
howToUse_en: Enter the vehicle purchase price and select your currency.
Enter your cash down payment or trade-in value.
Set the annual interest rate (APR) and loan term in months.
View your monthly payment and total accumulated interest.
content.methodology: Cálculo de amortización constante: C = P × [ i / (1 - (1 + i)^-n) ], donde P es el valor neto financiado (Precio - Enganche - Trade-In), i es el interés mensual y n los meses del préstamo.
content.methodology_en: Amortization formula: C = P × [ i / (1 - (1 + i)^-n) ], where P is net financed amount (Price - Down Payment - Trade-in), i is monthly interest, and n is total months.

guideSections.title: Auto Loan Overview
guideSections.title_es: Visión General del Préstamo de Auto
guideSections.content_html_en: An auto loan is a secured loan used to buy a new or used vehicle. The vehicle itself serves as collateral for the debt until fully paid.
guideSections.content_html: Un préstamo de auto es un crédito con garantía prendaria donde el propio vehículo sirve como aval de la deuda hasta liquidar las cuotas.

guideSections.title: Down Payment & Trade-In Value
guideSections.title_es: Enganche Inicial y Valor de Intercambio (Trade-In)
guideSections.content_html_en: Putting down at least 20% upfront for a new car (or 10% for used) helps offset initial vehicle depreciation and lowers your monthly payments and interest costs.
guideSections.content_html: Aportar al menos un 20% inicial de enganche compensa la rápida depreciación inicial del vehículo y reduce las cuotas mensuales.

guideSections.title: Loan Term vs Total Interest
guideSections.title_es: Plazo en Meses vs Intereses Totales
guideSections.content_html_en: Shorter terms (36-48 months) have higher monthly payments but lower total interest. Longer terms (60-72 months) lower monthly payments but increase total interest significantly.
guideSections.content_html: Plazos más cortos (36-48 meses) implican cuotas más altas pero menos intereses. Plazos más largos (60-72 meses) bajan la cuota pero duplican intereses.

guideSections.title: Financing Equations
guideSections.content_html_en:
Net Loan Amount: Principal = Vehicle Price - Down Payment - Trade-In
Monthly Payment: C = Principal × [ i / (1 - (1 + i)⁻ⁿ) ]
guideSections.content_html:
Monto Neto: Principal = Precio Auto - Enganche - Trade-In
Cuota Mensual: C = Principal × [ i / (1 - (1 + i)⁻ⁿ) ]

interpretation.label: Plazo largo
interpretation.text: Un plazo superior a 60 meses incrementa significativamente el costo total por intereses acumulados.
interpretation.text_en: A loan term over 60 months significantly increases total interest costs.
